name: Possessed Oracle
summary: Some oracles are possessed by spirits, demons, or similar beings.
replacesText: Oracle’s Curse; Mystery Bonus Spells; 1st-level Revelation

features.name: Oracle’s Curse
features.summary: A possessed oracle must choose the haunted or tongues curse at 1st level.

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.summary: ventriloquism (1st), spider climb (4th), screech (6th), sleepwalk (8th), telekinesis (10th), animate objects (12th), divine vessel (16th). These bonus spells replace the oracle’s normal mystery bonus spells at these levels.

features.name: Two Minds (Su)
features.summary: You gain a +2 bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells or effects. At 7th level, you may reroll a failed Will save once per day as an immediate action. You must take the second result, even if it is worse.

resourceActions.label: Reroll a failed Will save
resourceActions.summary: Reroll the d20 for a failed Will save and use the new roll even if it is lower.

featureOverrides.summary: Choose a mystery for its class skills, remaining bonus spells, revelations, and final revelation.

mechanicalNotes: The standard archetype curse choices, bonus spells, and Two Minds reroll are available. Track the selected curse’s individual effects and later published curse substitutions at the table.
